snippet.title: SAWAD | سواد - Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
In SAWAD, you and your friends are content creators desperate for FAME and subscribers. 
Break into haunted locations, eliminate whatever is there. 
Hidden CCTVs record it all. Make the clips go viral and get filthy rich! 
The only catch? You must survive long enough to hit upload.

Coming 22 October 2026 🔥
